auto_merge.commit_message:
Fixup to 6dcfa5a66885076994718eb40afd91acc4f57d72

`sys._is_gil_enabled()` changes if the GIL gets enabled at runtime, so isn't good for identifying the build.

To avoid complicated code generation and polluting the user namespace in gdb with imported modules, the venv checking was moved into a simple function.

comment_data.body:
`_is_gil_enabled` only exists for freethreaded builds (and tells you if it's switched into its fallback GIL-emulation mode). So the attribute doesn't exist on the Python 3.14 regular GIL build.

`has_gil` is misnamed though - it should be `is_freethreaded_build`

comment_data.body: I double-checked this and I was wrong about it. I've changed it to `sysconfig.get_config_var("Py_GIL_DISABLED")` which is what we use elsewhere. (`sys._is_gil_enabled()` definitely does change if the GIL gets enabled at runtime, so isn't good for identifying the build anyway)
